name: Universal Xiomeme-Leica Camera mod By Evorez (-Universal Cam Evorez)
notes: Frosted glassy-blur bottom card, Additional Tools tweaks panel, true AOSP 60fps freeze fix (0x803c -> 0x0 + Base.smali EIS/VideoSAT disabled), 100x Super Zoom, 0.5x Ultra-Wide + Telephoto (5x) zoom bar in Photo mode, Leica watermark, Lab & Universal settings removed, and version -Universal Cam Evorez.

patches.description: Replace APK package versionName (Universal 5.0 Beta 8.3) with -Universal Cam Evorez
Compile frosted glassy-blur EvorezCardPreference & Additional Tools tweaks UI
Disable Universal Settings feature flag completely
Remove Lab, Universal, and legacy HolyBear rows; attach Additional Tools & frosted glass Evorez card
Remove HolyBear, Sevtinge, and ItzDFPlayer credit label classes
Redirect in-app Telegram launcher link to https://t.me/evorezlabs
Replace MI PHONE watermark text with Leica across all device profiles
Replace MI Phone watermark text with Leica
Replace Mi Phone watermark text with Leica
Scrub legacy credit strings and MI Phone strings from resources.arsc in-place
Fix 60fps Video screen freeze on AOSP by replacing MIUI HSR60 opmode 0x803c with standard AOSP 0x0 (toggleable in Additional Tools)
Disable forced MIUI 4K EIS in Base.smali so AOSP video sessions do not stall
Disable forced MIUI SuperEIS in Base.smali to prevent AOSP video freeze
Disable MIUI virtual Video SAT (ID 62) in Base.smali so 60fps video runs smoothly on AOSP HAL
Disable MIUI SAT fallback state check in Base.smali for smooth AOSP video
Keep MIUI proprietary 60fps EIS disabled on AOSP HAL to prevent 60fps video freezing
Unlock smooth 1080p 60fps video recording on AOSP
Hook DataItemFeature.getMaxZoom() to 100x Super Zoom (toggleable in Additional Tools)
Hook Common.getMaxZoom() to 100x Super Zoom
Enable 0.5x Ultra-Wide + 1x + 2x + 5x Telephoto zoom points in DataItemFeature.P1
Enable 0.5x Ultra-Wide zoom support (toggleable in Additional Tools)
Enable multi-lens optical zoom toggle bar (0.5x / 1x / 2x / 5x)

Add 0.5x + Telephoto (5x) outer zoom buttons in Photo, Video, and Night modes (Base.smali)

Configure fallback Photo zoom ruler stops from 0.5x up to 100x in Base.smali
Lower ZoomConstant ultra-wide base ratio from 0.6f to 0.5f
Lower ZoomConstant default ultra-wide float constant from 0.6f to 0.5f
Set global zoom range from 0.5x up to 100x across modes (ZoomConstant$a b & c)
Set HybridZoomingSystem ultra-wide & telephoto zoom stops to 0.5:1:2:5:10:30:100
Set default HybridZoomingSystem zoom stops to 0.5:1:2:5:10:30:100
Lower ZoomManager minimum zoom clamp from 0.6f to 0.5f
Lower Base/Base2 device profile ultra-wide zoom from 0.6f to 0.5f

Force 100% lossless-grade JPEG_QUALITY in VirtualCameraReprocessor
